tp_search_summary: Read axum-extra/src/middleware.rs: BodyWrapper is a struct local to the remap_response_body test whose HttpBody methods are all unimplemented!(). The test only builds a Router with the layer and never serves or polls it, so no response body is created. Checked each pre-gathered size_hint grep hit (axum/src/routing/route.rs, axum-core/src/body.rs, axum-extra async_read_body.rs, typed_header.rs, axum-macros with_position.rs): each runs on a different body/iterator type and cannot receive a BodyWrapper because no request ever flows through the test router.
rationale: BodyWrapper::size_hint is a trait method of a test-local type that exists only to satisfy the HttpBody bound at compile time. The router that holds it is never driven, so route.rs's res.size_hint() and the Body wrappers in axum-core never run with a BodyWrapper inside. No real invocation exists.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The single prior tp verdict is correct.
